weakness: No account procedure, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; shared supplier and carrier accounts; carrier password unchanged after the technician left
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-008, R-009; P03 G-001
remediation_plan: Onboarding and termination checklist covering ERP, suite, supplier portals, carrier, alarm code, and keys; monthly account reconciliation (POL-02 B.4, B.5)
milestones: 2026-08-12 carrier password changed; 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 first monthly reconciliation
resources_required: Operations Manager time (1 hour a month)

weakness: Shared distributor portal and carrier logins; shared local administrator on the setup bench
remediation_plan: Named accounts in every supplier portal and the carrier service; named bench accounts with the administrator account held by the MSP; delete the password spreadsheet
milestones: 2026-09-30 named portal and carrier accounts; 2026-10-31 bench rebuilt
resources_required: MSP labor (part of the $900 bench rebuild)

weakness: Backup console, firewall management, and distributor portal administrator logins accept a password only
remediation_plan: MSP enables MFA on the backup console and firewall and sends screenshots; MFA on the distributor portal for all users

weakness: No security training at any point; April 2026 payment fraud not used in awareness
remediation_plan: Annual online training covering FCI, payment fraud, counterfeit and Section 889 awareness, and incident reporting; quarterly phishing simulations; monthly reminder
milestones: 2026-09-30 payment fraud briefing for the Bookkeeper and Owner; 2026-10-31 first annual training; 2026-12-31 first simulation

weakness: Inventory covers only computers; camera recorder and 4 cameras were covered equipment and not on any list
source: P07 test 2026-08-11 (new finding); P01 R-024; P03 G-017
remediation_plan: Disconnect and replace the covered devices; one-page inventory of all devices and SaaS with manufacturer of record; screen every company device against the covered list; counsel reviews the SAM representation and any report
milestones: 2026-08-12 devices disconnected; 2026-08-20 replaced; 2026-09-30 counsel decision recorded; 2026-10-31 inventory complete

weakness: Backups not immutable; 30-day versions; one password-only login can delete them; bench files not backed up
remediation_plan: 1-year immutable versions; MFA (POAM-003); quarterly restore test with a written result; bench job files kept in the suite FCI folder instead of locally

weakness: Staff do not know how and when to report; no route for Government reports
source: P07 interviews; P01 R-019; P03 G-018
remediation_plan: Reporting rule (POL-03 4.2) on a card at every desk; DIBNet accounts for the Owner and Federal Account Manager; contracting officer contacts in the binder
milestones: 2026-09-30 cards posted; 2026-10-15 DIBNet access tested; 2026-10-31 training

weakness: No sanitization procedure or records; 2 laptops disposed and 1 sent for repair without a wipe
remediation_plan: Disposal rule (POL-04 4.8); MSP wipes with a recorded method or certified destruction; disposal log
Sign-in sheet at the stockroom door kept 1 year; escort rule; individual alarm codes; key log
milestones: 2026-09-15 sign-in sheet in use; 2026-10-31 alarm codes and key log

weakness: No security terms or oversight for the MSP and SaaS vendors; MSP evidence not received; AI subprocessor terms unreviewed
remediation_plan: Annual MSP security review (technician list, RMM MFA evidence); FCI and no-training terms with the ERP vendor; 24-hour incident notice and recovery commitment in the MSP contract
milestones: 2026-09-30 MSP evidence received; 2026-10-31 ERP AI terms; 2026-12-31 MSP contract amendment

weakness: Firewall and recorder firmware not updated; no time limits; firmware not tested
remediation_plan: Firmware updated; 14-day limit for critical updates in the MSP contract; monthly firmware check of network devices; quarterly external scan
milestones: 2026-09-15 firewall firmware updated; 2026-10-31 contract terms; 2026-12-31 first scan

weakness: No acquisition strategy or screening; 310 SKUs without manufacturer of record
remediation_plan: Manufacturer of record for every SKU; screening list and ERP block on DoD quotes; authorized sources only for DoD orders; C-SCRM plan with broker approval
milestones: 2026-09-01 DoD orders from authorized sources only; 2026-10-31 SKU clean-up and ERP block; 2026-11-30 C-SCRM plan
resources_required: Purchasing and Federal Account Manager time

weakness: No inspection for tampering at receiving or at the setup bench
remediation_plan: Receiving checklist (seals, labels, weight, OEM serial validation for non-authorized items); firmware version or hash check at the bench before each job
milestones: 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 bench firmware check

weakness: No anti-counterfeit procedure or reporting rule
remediation_plan: Anti-counterfeit procedure in the C-SCRM plan: detection at receiving, quarantine, OEM validation, records kept with the ERP receipt, and reporting under POL-03 4.4 and 4.5
milestones: 2026-09-01 POL-02 A.8 and POL-03 in effect; 2026-11-30 procedure in the C-SCRM plan
